items.title: 19.3.1 Models Proposed for the Mechanism of DNA Replication (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the models of replication (PDF 123).

blocks.text: DNA replication ke bunyadi tareeqe ke liye teen models pesh kiye gaye.

blocks.alt: DNA molecules ke teen column, jore dar patiyan, purane strands gehre aur naye halke, do naslon tak. Conservative: aik bilkul purana aur aik bilkul naya molecule, phir aik purana aur teen naye. Semi-conservative: har beti molecule mein aik purana aur aik naya strand. Dispersive: har strand purane aur naye tukron ka mel.
blocks.caption: Do naslon tak teen models (Figure 19.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Teen models pesh kiye gaye. Conservative model mein walid double helix saalim rehta aur bilkul naya double helix banta hai, yaani aik beti mein dono purane aur doosri mein dono naye strands. Semi-conservative model mein walid strands alag ho kar har aik naye strand ka saancha (template) banta hai, yaani har beti mein aik purana aur aik naya strand. Dispersive model mein walid DNA toot jata aur purane aur naye tukre betiyon ke sab strands mein mil jate hain.

blocks.caption: Teen models
header: Aik replication ke baad beti DNAs
rows: Walid double helix saalim rehta aur bilkul naye maadde ka naya double helix banata hai.
Aik mein dono walid strands; aik mein dono naye strands.
Walid ke do strands alag hote aur har aik naye strand ka template banta hai.
Har aik mein aik walid strand aur aik naya strand.
Walid double helix toot kar nucleotides mein bikhar jata, jo naye nucleotides se mil kar chaar strands banate hain.
Sab strands purane aur naye nucleotides ka mel.

blocks.prompt: Semi-conservative model ke mutabiq do baar ke baad kitne DNA molecules mein asal strand baqi hai?
blocks.explanation: Chaar mein se do, yaani aadhe; baqi do bilkul naye hain.

items: Semi-conservative: har beti = 1 purana + 1 naya strand.
Dispersive: har strand mein purane aur naye tukre.
